card.name: The word split in dosing and general text
card.fires_on: The word "split" (or the "-D" of "Split-Dose") when it begins a term such as split-dose regimen, splitting tablets, split infinitive, split skirts or split samples.

card.writes: It has little link to the word split itself; the promoted tokens are "hands" and the suppressed ones are "head", so it adds a body-part word with no clear tie to this context.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "split", as in split-dose schedules or splitting tablets, and also in everyday uses.
